Package hadur117.micro.core

Class Movement

java.lang.Object
hadur117.micro.core.Movement
public final class Movement extends Object
Corner oscillation (MeleeSeed, as Figment runs it): the robot shuttles between two points near its nearest corner, one on each wall that meets there. Each point sits WALL px off its own wall and a leg along it, so whichever point the robot is heading for, it stops WALL px from an edge (SAOR-1). The axis flips each time a leg is done.

Pure statics on primitives, no engine types (SAOR-2). The shipped class hadur117.micro.Saor is this core flattened by hand; the bench adapter SaorLab calls it, and the equivalence test holds the two to the same orders (SAOR-15).

    • leg

      public static int leg(double targetDistance)
      How far along the wall, from the corner, the leg's point lies: 55 px plus 0.4 of the target's distance, so the robot swings wider when the fight is further off; 50 px after a collision (RAM_DISTANCE). An infinite distance (no target yet) overflows as it does in Figment and sends the robot at the far wall until the first scan.
      Parameters:
      targetDistance - the target's distance at its last scan
      Returns:
      the leg in px
